races.name: Book The Bistro At Southwell Racecourse Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Fern Hill
runners_data.note: Highest-rated but needs significant pace collapse to utilize hold-up style effectively over this trip

runners_data.name: Hell Hound
runners_data.note: Most progressive recent form with two wins, handles good ground well and suits prominent racing

runners_data.name: Queens Wish
runners_data.note: Consistent placer at this level but lacks a recent win to suggest breakthrough performance

runners_data.name: Always Busy
runners_data.note: Tactically versatile prominent runner whose inconsistent recent form creates uncertainty

runners_data.name: Le Beau Gosse
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated hold-up horse who needs everything to fall right including strong pace and luck in running

runners_data.name: Noche Negra
runners_data.note: Natural leader whose poor recent form suggests vulnerability despite likely uncontested early advantage

races.paceDynamic: Noche Negra will likely lead uncontested early, with Hell Hound, Queens Wish, and Always Busy settling just off the pace in a prominent cluster. This sets up a tactical battle from the 2f pole onwards, with hold-up horses Fern Hill and Le Beau Gosse needing the pace to collapse to be competitive over this stamina-sapping trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace holds up
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio (Hell Hound, Queens Wish, Always Busy) maintain pressure on Noche Negra throughout
scenarios.body: The pace stays honest, preventing a sprint finish and suiting horses with proven stamina reserves. Hell Hound's recent Goodwood form and Queens Wish's consistency at this level give them the edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader kicks clear early
scenarios.trigger: If Noche Negra establishes a commanding lead by halfway with minimal pressure from behind
scenarios.body: The prominent horses fail to engage early, allowing the leader to dictate completely before the hold-up horses can mount a challenge. Noche Negra's front-running style becomes decisive despite moderate recent form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian with all prominent horses content to wait
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish from 3f out, heavily favoring Fern Hill's proven hold-up tactics. The OR 110 horse gets the perfect setup to unleash a telling late burst over lesser-rated rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy tactical affair
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses refuse to commit early, creating stop-start fractions and bunching
scenarios.body: The race fragments with false dawns and multiple lead changes, creating chaos that could suit an opportunistic ride. Always Busy's tactical versatility or Le Beau Gosse finding gaps becomes crucial in the scramble.

watchPoints.text: If Hell Hound travels strongly 4f out after his two recent wins, the consistent form horse becomes very dangerous
Watch if Queens Wish gets a soft lead-up position behind Noche Negra, as her stamina reserves could prove telling
Monitor Always Busy's early positioning - if settling kindly prominent, his tactical flexibility becomes an asset
If the pace is genuinely strong early, Fern Hill's hold-up style and superior OR rating make him the primary beneficiary
Watch for Le Beau Gosse getting a clear run 3f out, as traffic problems could easily end his chances

races.name: Easter Family Fun Day 5th April Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Ukantango
runners_data.note: Recent form is poor with jumping errors, but retains class advantage if finding old rhythm

runners_data.name: Big Boy Barney
runners_data.note: Won last time out at this trip on good going, hold-up style suits race shape perfectly

runners_data.name: Kayce Dutton
runners_data.note: Has winning form at longer trips and won recently, though moving from soft to good going

runners_data.name: Gilbertina
runners_data.note: Lowest rated but consistent, prominent style could see her involved if pace collapses

runners_data.name: Intenzo
runners_data.note: Natural front runner in this field, recent good going form gives him tactical advantage

runners_data.name: Boston Boy
runners_data.note: Inconsistent recent form but won over 18f last year, needs everything to fall right

races.paceDynamic: Intenzo will likely lead or sit prominent early with Gilbertina potentially tracking, creating a moderate pace that should suit the quartet of hold-up horses. With four runners (Ukantango, Big Boy Barney, Kayce Dutton, Boston Boy) all preferring to come from behind, the race sets up for a sustained finish where positioning and jumping accuracy will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Intenzo Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Intenzo gets an uncontested lead and maintains strong jumping
scenarios.body: Intenzo dictates fractions without pressure and has enough left to resist the late charge. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on this trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Big Boy Barney Powers Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady and Big Boy Barney gets the perfect hold-up trip
scenarios.body: Big Boy Barney's superior recent winning form tells as he times his challenge perfectly in the straight. His good going record gives him the edge over his hold-up rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kayce Dutton Stays Strongest
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a true test of stamina over this longer trip
scenarios.body: Kayce Dutton's experience at 24f trips proves decisive as others weaken in the final furlong. His recent Southwell win shows he's in form despite the going switch.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ukantango Times Run Perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If Ukantango gets luck in running and avoids his recent jumping errors
scenarios.body: Despite recent poor form, Ukantango's class advantage shows when getting a clean passage through. His hold-up style works if he can jump cleanly and find his old rhythm.

watchPoints.text: Ukantango's jumping - recent falls and errors could end his chances early despite class edge
Intenzo's stamina reserves - if he goes too fast early he may not last home over this extended trip
Big Boy Barney's position turning in - needs to be handy enough to mount his challenge
How Kayce Dutton handles the going change from recent soft ground runs to today's good surface
Whether Gilbertina can maintain her prominent position when the pace inevitably quickens

runners_data.name: Papillondelumiere

runners_data.name: Novelista
runners_data.note: Strong recent heavy ground form but inconsistent record on similar good going conditions

runners_data.name: Road To Wembley
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner with excellent good going record who should get uncontested lead

runners_data.name: Top Coeur
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with limited experience but solid recent form on good ground

runners_data.name: Lou Des Bordes
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with tendency to fade in finish despite high rating

runners_data.name: Paragon
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner behind the leader, giving him ideal tactical position

runners_data.name: Promethean
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated but hold-up style suits if pace collapses into sprint finish

runners_data.name: Corsican Caper
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer but poor record on similar going conditions

races.paceDynamic: Road To Wembley will take them along from the front without pressure, setting a sustainable gallop that should suit the strong contingent of hold-up horses. With only Paragon likely to race prominently behind the leader, this creates an ideal scenario for closers like Novelista, Top Coeur, Corsican Caper and Promethean to get into the race late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Field
scenarios.trigger: If Road To Wembley sets steady fractions and the hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows multiple closers to wind up together turning for home. Novelista and Top Coeur benefit most from the tactical setup with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Road To Wembley quickens turning for home before the closers organize
scenarios.body: His good going record and front-running style catch the hold-up brigade napping in a slowly-run race. Paragon's prominent position gives him the best chance of the chasers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly after halfway on this testing track
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop finds out the lightly-raced types and favors proven stayers. Novelista's recent heavy ground form and Corsican Caper's consistency come to the fore.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset from Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Promethean's hold-up style works perfectly in a bunched finish where class matters less. His low rating becomes irrelevant in a cavalry charge to the line.

watchPoints.text: Road To Wembley could steal this if he quickens before the closers get organized
Lou Des Bordes has shown a pattern of fading late despite his high rating
Novelista's inconsistent good going record is a concern despite recent heavy ground success
Papillondelumiere's pace style at the start will reveal tactical intentions
How quickly the field bunches turning for home will determine if closers get clear runs

races.name: Southwell Racecourse Conference And Events Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Immortal Fame
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who will set the standard but needs to prove stamina over this extended trip

runners_data.name: El Galactico
runners_data.note: Highest-rated horse with excellent going record who excels when getting strong pace to aim at

runners_data.name: Jubilant
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer whose course win came from similar position in competitive handicap

runners_data.name: Moon Hunter
runners_data.note: Reliable each-way type who finds his level in handicaps and handles good ground well

runners_data.name: Passing Pleasure
runners_data.note: In-form prominent racer whose recent soft ground wins suggest he's found his form

runners_data.name: Ocean Conquest
runners_data.note: Front-running type whose best course form came over shorter trips but has winning form on good ground

runners_data.name: Campaign Trail
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner whose good ground record includes course-and-distance placings

runners_data.name: Diamond Geezer
runners_data.note: Course winner last time who specializes in hold-up tactics and has strong Southwell record

races.paceDynamic: Immortal Fame will lead from the front with Passing Pleasure, Ocean Conquest and Campaign Trail tracking prominently, creating a sustainable gallop over this staying trip. The large contingent of hold-up horses (El Galactico, Jubilant, Moon Hunter, Diamond Geezer) will rely on the pace being strong enough to set up their finishing kicks in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop suits closers
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses maintain honest pace throughout
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get the strong gallop they need with El Galactico and Jubilant best positioned to capitalize. Diamond Geezer's recent Southwell win gives him claims if getting the right setup from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners steal march
scenarios.trigger: If Immortal Fame and Passing Pleasure dictate with controlled pace
scenarios.body: The leaders get soft sectionals and kick clear before the closers can respond effectively. Ocean Conquest and Campaign Trail are best placed to track and challenge the pace-setters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too fast early and tie up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Diamond Geezer's recent course form and El Galactico's class tell. Jubilant has shown he can quicken when getting the right setup from off the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-race battle fragments field
scenarios.trigger: If Ocean Conquest and Campaign Trail engage the leaders turning for home
scenarios.body: The early pace battle leaves gaps for the hold-up horses but also sets up a war of attrition. Jubilant's stamina and Moon Hunter's consistency could prove decisive in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Immortal Fame gets an uncontested lead as his stamina over this trip remains questionable
Monitor how quickly El Galactico and Jubilant can get into contention from their hold-up positions
Check if Passing Pleasure can maintain his recent soft ground form on this better surface
Observe whether the pace is strong enough early to set up Diamond Geezer's preferred finishing kick
Note if Ocean Conquest settles better than usual rather than forcing the pace from the start

runners_data.name: Rosa Diaz
runners_data.note: Highest-rated hold-up horse with consistent recent form, suits patient tactics

runners_data.name: Princesse Milania

runners_data.name: Belladinotte

runners_data.name: Shorten Sassy
runners_data.note: Only other pace angle, recent form shows she handles this distance well

runners_data.name: Mya Du Clos

runners_data.name: Venturevango
runners_data.note: Consistent fade pattern in recent runs limits finishing threat despite rating

races.paceDynamic: Briery Butterfly and Shorten Sassy will likely set a measured pace early with only two forward-running types in this small field. The race sets up perfectly for the five hold-up horses (Rosa Diaz, Princesse Milania, Belladinotte, Mya Du Clos, Venturevango) to get their preferred patient tactics, creating a tactical affair with plenty left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Hold-Up Winner
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is truly steady and the race becomes a sprint from 2f out
scenarios.body: Rosa Diaz and Princesse Milania have the class edge and finishing kick to capitalize. The patient tactics suit their proven ability to find late gears when the race opens up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Capitalizes
scenarios.trigger: If Briery Butterfly gets easy fractions and kicks clear 3f out
scenarios.body: With limited pace pressure, she can dictate terms and use her prominent style effectively. Shorten Sassy could also benefit from tracking the leader in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Belladinotte Value Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens enough to stretch the field but not collapse it completely
scenarios.body: Her superior going form (1W 4P in 13 similar going starts) and hold-up style could exploit a moderate pace scenario. The tactical nature plays to her patient running style despite lower rating.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Briery Butterfly and Shorten Sassy fade dramatically from 3f out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any of the hold-up horses could prevail. Venturevango's known finishing weakness becomes less relevant in a truly-run race.

watchPoints.text: Venturevango repeatedly fades in the final stages based on recent form pattern
Briery Butterfly needs to establish early position without being pressured by Shorten Sassy
Rosa Diaz requires clear room in final 2f given her hold-up style in small field
Mya Du Clos stepping up significantly in trip from recent 16f efforts
Field composition heavily favors patient tactics with limited early pace
